articles.headline: FIFA defends semifinal referee after France, Deschamps criticism
articles.description: FIFA's director of refereeing Pierluigi Collina defended the referee in Tuesday's semifinal between France and Spain following criticism from France coach Didier Deschamps.

articles.headline: Harry Kane becomes England's second most capped player of all time
articles.description: Harry Kane is now England's second most capped player of all time, as he started Wednesday's World Cup semifinal against Argentina.

articles.headline: Post Malone, Tom Cruise, IShowSpeed headline World Cup closing ceremony
articles.description: A wide array of performers, from Post Malone to Tom Cruise to streamer IShowSpeed, will help close out the World Cup, FIFA said Tuesday.

articles.headline: Morgan Rogers, Djed Spence and Reece James start for England in Argentina semifinal showdown
articles.description: England have made three changes for their World Cup semifinal against Argentina with Morgan Rogers, Djed Spence and Reece James all starting.

articles.headline: Rogers, Spence & James start: Reacting to England's XI to face Argentina
articles.description: Rogers, Spence & James start: Reacting to England's XI to face Argentina

articles.headline: Fans can pay $80 to attend pre-World Cup final news conference
articles.description: FIFA is to stage the World Cup final news conference in front of paying fans with supporters having to pay in excess of $80 (£60) to watch the coaches and players from the two finalists.
